description: This file defines the 'Each' class which provides static methods to handle collections of promises, including executing promises with a concurrency limit and handling their fulfillment or rejection. It is part of the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, focusing on promise aggregation strategies.

classes.name: Each
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing collections of promises with different concurrency control strategies.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an aggregate promise that resolves when all promises in the iterable have been fulfilled or if any is rejected, with optional fulfillment and rejection handlers.

methods.name: ofLimit
methods.description: Creates an aggregate promise that processes promises in the iterable with a specified concurrency limit, with optional handlers.

methods.name: ofLimitAll
methods.description: Creates an aggregate promise that processes promises with a concurrency limit and rejects immediately if any promise is rejected.
